items.html: And behold, according to this, it would have been fitting not to call this Shema that is upon the bed, until midnight, for the aforementioned reason. But we recite the Shema before we sleep: for afterwards, at midnight, the coupling is made above by means of our souls, as will be said with the help of God. Therefore we recite the Shema while we are still standing in this world, before we deposit our souls above, and our intention is that this Shema should benefit the coupling at midnight, as mentioned.
